models_evaluated: YNHHS internal ECG signal-based SHD model
YNHHS internal ECG image-based SHD model

links.outcome: Test-retest reliability of AI-ECG outputs across repeated ECGs 1-30 days apart
links.effect: Composite CCCs 0.90 (signal), 0.90 (image), 0.81 (EchoNext-Mini); disease-specific CCCs 0.77-0.86 and 0.50-0.97 for EchoNext-Mini nodes; image ensemble categorical concordance 87-89% versus 80-84% for disease-specific models.
links.quote: The image-based ensemble model achieved categorical screen-status concordance of 87-89% across 3 health systems (versus 80-84% for disease-specific models).

unlisted_practices: Using ensemble composite models to improve test-retest reliability of AI-ECG outputs
Using serial changes in AI-ECG screen status to predict new-onset heart failure

screen.reason: Multicenter retrospective evaluation of test-retest reliability and serial discordance of AI-ECG models across different health systems.
